milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The redstone_block is embedded in the south wall at (0,1,2). Player must step forward from spawn (distance ~2.5 blocks from eye position) and face it. Max_distance=2 prevents auto-satisfaction on spawn. Facing_tolerance=45° ensures deliberate observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch_button is wall-mounted on the east wall at (2,1,0). Player must turn east and face it. Max_distance=4 allows observation from within the hub room.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce_pressure_plate is on the floor at (-2,0,-2) at the south corridor threshold. Player must navigate to the corridor entrance and look toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple_stained_glass_pane is at (6,2,2) on the south wall of the east room. Player must navigate through the east corridor and face the window. Max_distance=6 allows viewing from within the corridor.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block', max_count=0) because glass drops NOTHING without Silk Touch enchantment — inventory_has cannot work. Verifies the block was destroyed by confirming zero magenta_stained_glass blocks remain in a generous box encompassing the east room window area where the glass is placed at (7,2,2).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black_wall_banner is at (-3,2,-9) — placed in the air block in front of the south wall at z=-10, facing south toward the approaching player. Max_distance=6 allows viewing from the room doorway.

Uses inventory_has because mining stone with a pickaxe drops cobblestone (standard Minecraft mechanic — stone always drops cobblestone without Silk Touch). The stone blocks are in the south corridor at floor level. No other cobblestone source exists in this scene, so cobblestone in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_cactus is at (-1,0,-9) on the floor in the back of the final room. Player must navigate to the deepest point of the dungeon and face it. Max_distance=6 allows viewing from within the room.
